topics.label: 事业职位

regressionExamples: 朋友介绍的面试，最后能不能录用？

modernSemanticHypotheses.focus: promotion, regularization or position advancement outcome
whether to move to or remain in a specific job/employer

collisionBoundaries: salary or pay amount remains income_salary
bonus or performance payout remains income_bonus
an employer or colleague mentioned as background does not by itself create a career route
generic financial benefit of a job must not collapse career outcome into financial_fortune

topics.label: 考试学业

regressionExamples: 出国留学申请会不会顺利

modernSemanticHypotheses.focus: specific examination result, pass/fail or ranking outcome
admission/application outcome or choice among study destinations

collisionBoundaries: documents or application materials mentioned without an education goal do not create study_exam
tuition/payment questions remain financial routes when money is the current target
job qualification examinations must be adjudicated by the user's current target rather than keyword priority

topics.label: 出行

regressionExamples: 明天出行路上安不安全
坐这趟航班会不会延误
旅游目的地天气好不好

modernSemanticHypotheses.focus: whether a specific trip or itinerary proceeds as intended
safety-focused question about a specific journey
delay, cancellation or transport disruption of a specific journey

collisionBoundaries: destination weather remains outside the route when weather itself is the target
delivery arrival remains receive_item when an item rather than the querent's journey is the target
purchase of tickets or travel goods remains item_purchase when purchase suitability is the target

topics.label: 诉讼纠纷

regressionExamples: 会不会被对方反咬一口

modernSemanticHypotheses.focus: outcome of a specific lawsuit, arbitration or formal proceeding
settlement or resolution of a bounded dispute
specific expected action of the opposing party inside a dispute context

collisionBoundaries: ordinary contract negotiation remains commercial_transaction when no dispute/proceeding is the target
debt recovery remains debt_collection when collection itself is the current target and litigation is only a method
counterparty mention alone must not create litigation_dispute

topics.label: 失物

regressionExamples: 手机丢在哪里了还能找到吗
宠物走丢了能不能自己回来

modernSemanticHypotheses.focus: whether a specific lost inanimate property item can be recovered
where a specific lost inanimate property item is located

collisionBoundaries: a delayed shipment remains receive_item rather than lost_property unless actual loss is the target
an item purchase question remains item_purchase
lost pets, children, family, friends or missing persons are not lost_property

nextSteps: Keep all routeIds above design-only until the current 22-route baseline is promotable.
Research and register traditional observation rules independently; legacy heuristic targets are not Rule Registry evidence.
Define formal Intent/Event schemas and Sufficiency slots before producing any training corpus.
Build cross-theme collision matrices before adding new Router labels.
When expansion training begins, preserve a frozen current-22 regression set and add new-theme outside/near-domain negatives.
